in_sanskrit.name: Viku
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little warrior
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Viku एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Viku is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vik', meaning war and battle. It is a powerful name, suggesting strength, courage, and the ability to overcome challenges. It is also associated with the sun, symbolizing warmth, energy, and illumination.
